description: Designations of the eleven Slovenian registration areas (registracijska območja). Article 29(1) of the Pravilnik o registraciji motornih in priklopnih vozil names the areas — Celje, Koper, Kranj, Krško, Ljubljana, Maribor, Murska Sobota, Nova Gorica, Novo mesto, Postojna, Slovenj Gradec — and article 29(2) puts their designations in Priloga IV, which is the official list reproduced here: CE, KP, KR, KK, LJ, MB, MS, GO, NM, PO, SG. The designation opens every ordinary and export plate; historic plates carry 'MV' and test plates 'PR' in its place (arts. 40-41), so those two values are deliberately absent from this table.
